name: L10 PanoLab fresh long-short exact-token bank Development
question: On four newly frozen target-way/item/sequence-disjoint active-view episodes across three cities, does a long-short exact-token bank recover more target-name lexical candidates than the frozen whole-row/group-sign predecessor while preserving zero wrong-target matches and never creating a portal-ownership binding?

source_receipt.v1_selection: Rejected before materialization because two Intermarche items appeared in prior reference-portal evidence; V2 excluded them without changing other ranking rules.
source_receipt.v2_console_transport: The V2 selection file was fully written before a Windows GBK console print error; JSON, counts and SHA-256 were verified, and materialization then completed with UTF-8 console mode.

observation_window.anchor: strict OSM entrance ray under the unchanged zero-pose Panoramax contract
observation_window.sampling: native equirectangular pixels with horizontal seam wrap and no resampling
observation_window.ocr: frozen PP-OCRv6 medium detection and recognition ONNX

lexical_match.normalization: Unicode NFKD ASCII fold, lowercase alphanumeric tokens
lexical_match.exact_name_rule: Frozen predecessor: all significant target-name tokens contiguous in one OCR row.

long_short_token_bank.multi_token_target_rule: require max(2, ceil(0.6 * significant target tokens)), capped by target length
long_short_token_bank.association: Exact normalized token equality only; union witnesses across rows and the two reciprocal same-sequence frames.
long_short_token_bank.authority: Lexical candidate only; no row, token, frame, or bank gains portal or entrance ownership authority.

evidence_semantics.predecessor: The frozen whole-row exact-name plus grouped two-initial brand-sign matcher, evaluated both after-only and as a two-frame union.
evidence_semantics.successor: A long-short memory bank of exact target-name tokens pooled across OCR rows and the verified start/after action edge.
evidence_semantics.counterfactuals: Each episode's two-frame bank is evaluated against all three other fresh target names, for twelve wrong-target trials.
evidence_semantics.component_separation: Lexical candidates, geometry roles, and entrance rays remain separate fields; no ownership binding is emitted.

research_basis.title: GoMatching++: Parameter- and Data-Efficient Arbitrary-Shaped Video Text Spotting and Benchmarking
research_basis.use: Its long- and short-term matching memory motivates pooling stable text evidence across recent and historical frames; this evaluator uses a deterministic exact-token bank rather than its learned tracker.

research_basis.title: GloTSFormer: Global Video Text Spotting Transformer
research_basis.use: Its global historical association motivates retaining evidence beyond adjacent-frame-only matching; this evaluator does not implement the Transformer or claim benchmark comparability.

execution_rule: Freeze source selection before download, then freeze this evaluator, model hashes, exact-token rules, gates and counterfactuals before the first OCR/model call on the selected pixels. Run one output-bearing replay and refuse overwrite.

claim_boundary.allowed: Fresh target-way/item/prior-active-sequence-disjoint Development evidence, on four selected Panoramax episodes across three cities, about whether a component-separated long-short exact-token bank improves lexical-candidate availability over the frozen predecessor while post-action geometry remains independently DIRECT.
not_allowed: a lexical candidate being the target entity rather than a same-name sign, street, or distractor
pixel portal grounding or address/sign-to-door ownership
entrance affordance, public/legal access, walkability, collision-free traversability
waypoint accuracy, arrival, HANDOFF_READY, user benefit, deployment performance, or safety
